inventory.description: SmartTable OTS SmartStation UT2 48-12, isolated optical table, 4 ft x 8 ft x 12 in, 1/4-20 holes, ST-UT2

surface_h.note: Same value in OTS-I mechanical outline row OTS-xxx-48-12-I: F=40.7 in, G=1034 mm. Height is with isolators floating.

leg_w.quote: 6.0 inches which is the isolator base dimension
leg_w.note: From SmartTable OTS user manual (90026760 Rev C), sec. 1.5. Leg weldment cross-section itself is not dimensioned anywhere found; 6 in square is a reasonable box; leg modelled as an isolator-base-sized square column; true leg cross-section not published

leg_inset_x.note: Dimension E (side view): outer face to outer face of the legs at the two table ends. Implied inset from each short table edge = (96.0-91.6)/2 = 2.2 in (55.9 mm); derived: (2438.4-2326.6)/2 + leg_w/2 = leg centre inset

leg_inset_y.note: Dimension D (end view): outer face to outer face of the two legs of one leg weldment. Implied inset from each long table edge to the outer face of a leg = (48.0; derived: (1219.2-1107.4)/2 + leg_w/2

hole_pitch.note: Outline: '1.00 TYP HOLE TO HOLE DISTANCE [25.4]'.

hole_offset_x.note: Product page also: 'Mounting Hole Borders 0.5 in.' => 48 x 96 holes on 4x8 ft top.

hole_offset_y.note: Product page also: 'Mounting Hole Borders 0.5 in.' => 48 x 96 holes on 4x8 ft top.

tie_bar_h.note: OTS frame has 2 leg weldments + 3 cross braces (datasheet); not modelled yet

notes: product discontinued (replacement TF-48-24-I); 'SmartStation' is not a Newport term
